page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m2.8xlarge is an x86_64 virtual instance built on KVM virtualization within the General Purpose family hierarchy. The configuration supplies 32 dedicated Intel Xeon vCPUs operating at 2.7 GHz paired with 64.0 GB of system memory. This architecture establishes a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, allocating 2.0 GB of memory per core. The instance includes no discrete graphics processors or hardware acceleration modules.

Storage and networking configurations reflect a modular cloud layout. The instance includes no local disk storage, requiring network-attached cloud storage volumes for operating system and application persistent state. Baseline network throughput is rated at 16 Gbps, supporting stable inter-service communication and data ingress. Zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with the hardware profile, requiring external network configuration for public routing.

The 1:2 resource allocation ratio delivers compute density without excess memory overhead, providing cost efficiency for processing-intensive tasks. The primary operational tradeoff involves the reliance on networked block storage for all I/O requirements. This hardware configuration is suited for compute-heavy parallel workloads, including continuous integration and deployment pipelines, batch processing engines, multi-threaded worker nodes, and scalable web application servers.
